## Welcome

Welcome to the Virtual Bioinformatics New Mexico INBRE Summer Experience (NISE)! You will learn bioinformatics skills and apply them to researching chronic diseases. The majority of Americans have at least one chronic disease and while the prevalence of these chronic conditions increases with age, the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) estimates that even the majority (60%) of young people (ages 18-34) have at least one chronic disease. Furthermore, chronic diseases in the United States represent many of the leading causes of death and disability and their prevalence is expected to double by 2050. We will explore underlying causes (genetic and environmental), medical and lifestyle interventions, especially those that apply to multiple chronic diseases, as well as the diseases themselves. These diseases are diverse, including heart disease, diabetes, kidney disease, cancer, and many respiratory, gastrointestinal, neurological, musculoskeletal (including chronic pain), and infectious diseases, in addition to mental health conditions.

## Installations

Computer requirements:\
Windows 7, 8, 10 or later \
Mac Sierra or later\
(No Chromebooks) 

1. [Zoom](https://zoom.us/download)

Install the correct version for your OS. Don't plan to use the web version, as this does not have enough features.

2. [Tabby](https://tabby.sh) (terminal application)

3. [Filezilla](https://filezilla-project.org/) (file transfer)
